judoka.bio: Japanese extra-lightweight Funa Tonaki won the 2017 world title and Olympic silver in Tokyo.
Czech heavyweight Luka Krpalek is a two-time Olympic champion who also won Olympic gold at half-heavyweight.
Japanese half-heavyweight Aaron Wolf won Olympic gold at Tokyo 2020.
Spanish extra-lightweight Francisco Garrigós won the 2023 world title and Olympic bronze at Paris 2024.
Nina Cutro-Kelly represented the United States in the women’s heavyweight division at the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games.
Japanese extra-lightweight Natsumi Tsunoda won Olympic gold at Paris 2024 and is a multiple world champion.
Georgian middleweight Lasha Bekauri won Olympic gold at Tokyo 2020 and Paris 2024.
Georgian half-heavyweight Ilia Sulamanidze won Olympic silver at Paris 2024 in the men’s 100 kg division.
Brazilian heavyweight Beatriz Souza won Olympic gold at Paris 2024.
Dutch middleweight Kim Polling won the 2013 world title at 70 kg.
Kazakh extra-lightweight Yeldos Smetov completed an Olympic medal set by winning gold at Paris 2024.
Azerbaijani half-heavyweight Zelim Kotsoiev won Olympic gold at Paris 2024 and has medalled at world championships.
American half-heavyweight Kayla Harrison won Olympic gold medals in London and Rio.
French heavyweight Teddy Riner won individual Olympic gold in 2012, 2016, and 2024.
Japanese judoka Shōzō Fujii won four consecutive world titles during the 1970s in the divisions now represented by 81 kg.
French half-middleweight Clarisse Agbégnénou is a multiple Olympic and world champion.
Canadian lightweight Christa Deguchi won Olympic gold at Paris 2024 and world silver in 2024.
Brazilian lightweight Rafaela Silva won Olympic gold at Rio 2016 and is a multiple world champion.
British lightweight Chelsie Giles won Olympic bronze at Tokyo 2020 and world silver in 2022.
Tatsuuma Ushiyama is a fictional Golden Kamuy character: an escaped convict and formidable judo master known as “Ushiyama the Undefeated.”
German half-heavyweight Anna-Maria Wagner won world titles in 2021 and 2024.
Japanese half-lightweight Hifumi Abe won Olympic gold at Tokyo 2020 and is a multiple world champion.
Japanese extra-lightweight Naohisa Takato is an Olympic champion and three-time world champion.
Uzbek half-lightweight Diyora Keldiyorova won Olympic gold at Paris 2024 and is a world championship medallist.
French heavyweight Romane Dicko is a world champion and an Olympic bronze medallist in the individual heavyweight event.
Mexican half-middleweight Prisca Awiti-Alcaraz won silver at Paris 2024, Mexico's first Olympic judo medal.
Uzbek half-heavyweight Muzafarbek Turoboyev won the 2022 world title and competed at the Paris 2024 Olympic Games.
Italian half-heavyweight Alice Bellandi won Olympic gold at Paris 2024 after becoming a world championship medallist.
Azerbaijani lightweight Hidayat Heydarov won world gold in 2023 and Olympic gold at Paris 2024.
Ashley McKenzie is a British-born lightweight who has represented both Great Britain and Jamaica in international judo.
Mongolian extra-lightweight Baasankhuu Bavuudorj won the 2024 world title and Olympic silver.
Japanese half-middleweight Takanori Nagase is an Olympic champion and world champion.
An unnamed mentor from the fictional world of Judo Boy, this judoka teaches the protagonist while he trains in Bhutan.
Japanese half-lightweight Uta Abe is an Olympic champion and multiple world champion at 52 kg.
Tajik heavyweight Temur Rakhimov won bronze at Paris 2024 and is a multiple World Tour medallist.
Japanese lightweight Shohei Ono is a two-time Olympic champion and three-time world champion.
Portuguese lightweight Joana Ramos competed internationally in the 52 kg division across three Olympic Games.
Croatian middleweight Barbara Matic is a two-time world champion and the Olympic champion from Paris 2024.

techniques.name: Kani-basami
techniques.description: Scissors throw, performed by scissoring the opponent's body with the legs (prohibited in competition).

techniques.name: Seoi-nage
techniques.description: A shoulder throw where the opponent is lifted and thrown over the shoulder.
